name: Aster
source:
A lieutenant of the Imperial army.
He dreamed of continuing his magical education, but fate decided otherwise. Now he oversees the training of recruits with extraordinary magical potential.
He has the usual magical potential, but this is not always enough to defeat more talented opponents.
